# Vallabh Dental Care

> Vallabh Dental Care is a modern, sterilized, and ethical dental clinic located in Sector 6, Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Led by Dr. Medha Upadhyay (BDS, MDS Prosthodontics), the clinic provides specialized treatments including single-sitting rotary root canals, permanent dental implants, ultrasonic teeth scaling and whitening, clear aligners, painless extractions, and gentle pediatric dentistry.

## Flagship Dental Treatments
1. **Root Canal Treatment (Single-sitting RCT):**
   - Microscopic digital rotary endodontics with electronic apex locators and bio-ceramic sealing to eliminate deep pulp pain and save natural teeth without discomfort. Custom zirconia and ceramic crown caps.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#root-canal

2. **Permanent Dental Implants:**
   - 100% bio-compatible titanium fixtures anchored into the jawbone to restore chewing power, stop bone resorption, and replace single, multiple, or full-arch missing teeth permanently.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#dental-implants

3. **Teeth Whitening & Cleaning:**
   - Hospital-grade ultrasonic scaling to eliminate calcified calculus, tartar, and sub-gingival biofilm (preventing pyorrhea and bleeding gums), followed by safe enamel brightening for stain removal.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#teeth-whitening-cleaning

4. **Orthodontics & Clear Aligners:**
   - Discreet transparent aligners (invisible braces) and aesthetic ceramic brackets to fix crooked teeth, gaps, and malocclusions with zero food restrictions.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#orthodontics-aligners

5. **Painless & Wisdom Tooth Extractions:**
   - Minimally invasive atraumatic extractions and surgical wisdom tooth removals with targeted local anesthesia for comfortable procedures and rapid healing.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#painless-extractions

6. **Kids & Family Dentistry:**
   - Pediatric dentistry in a reassuring, friendly environment: cavity-preventing pit & fissure sealants, fluoride shields, habit counseling, and holistic family checkups.
   - URL: https://www.vallabhdental.in/treatments#kids-family-dentistry

## Core Clinical Pillars
- **Hospital-Grade Sterilization:** Ranked as the most hygienic dental clinic in Khargapur, utilizing multi-tier autoclave sterilization, bio-medical waste segregation, and single-use disposable kits.
- **Gentle & Painless Dentistry:** Advanced local anesthetics, rotary instruments, and atraumatic techniques designed to eliminate dental phobia.
- **Doctor-Led Personalized Attention:** Every patient is personally evaluated and treated by Dr. Medha Upadhyay with dedicated consultation time.
- **100% Transparent & Ethical Pricing:** Upfront treatment estimates with zero hidden fees and no unnecessary procedures.

## Common Patient FAQs
- **Q: Are root canal treatments painful?**
  - **A:** No. With modern rotary endodontics and local anesthetics practiced by Dr. Medha Upadhyay, RCT is comfortable and comparable to a routine filling.
- **Q: How long do dental implants last?**
  - **A:** With regular oral hygiene and routine maintenance, titanium dental implants have an over 95% clinical success rate and are engineered to last a lifetime.
- **Q: Do you offer Sunday consultations?**
  - **A:** Yes, the clinic is open every Sunday from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM for scheduled appointments and emergency consultations.
- **Q: How can I book an appointment?**
  - **A:** Call or WhatsApp +91 92361 63027, or visit the clinic at Sector 6, Khargapur, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow.
